Migration.Sources: docs/requirements.xml; docs/development-plan.xml; docs/functional-audit-findings.md; existing UI modules
Migration.Purpose: UX and operator guidance derived from the legacy use cases and the current Flutter screens.

Navigation.Management: Show cabin temperature, driver/passenger selection, mode selection, and manual heat level controls.
Navigation.Presets: Use a driver/passenger selector, editable preset settings, selected-state highlight, apply, and delete actions.
Navigation.Settings: Keep global theme and cabin-temperature visibility controls focused and bounded.

InteractionRules.ImmediateFeedback: Manual level changes update visible state and issue the HVAC command without waiting for a later sensor event.
InteractionRules.ModeSeparation: Manual, automatic, and presets modes remain distinct; applying a preset must not overwrite global automatic-mode settings.
InteractionRules.SafeFallback: Deleting the active preset falls back to manual mode with level zero.
InteractionRules.TemperatureDisplay: Temperature reads are cached and update through independent listeners without changing seat level by themselves.

Accessibility.Service: Accessibility service wake-up is supported for background lifecycle recovery.
Accessibility.Contrast: Theme variants and white-theme button contrast are covered by widget verification.
Accessibility.Layout: Controls must remain readable and bounded on the head-unit display; settings and preset sections avoid unbounded vertical expansion.

Diagnostics.DebugMode: Long-press on the cabin-temperature indicator exposes in-memory logs and a temperature injector for controlled diagnosis.
Diagnostics.Reset: Disabling debug mode restores the real HVAC temperature and clears LogRingBuffer side effects.
Diagnostics.Privacy: No secrets or sensitive user data are present; raw native property values are redacted outside debug logging.
